tasks.short: Read work orders to determine cutting dimensions, locations and quantities.

steps.what: Locate the actual current work order and its cutting requirement sections
inputs: actual current production work order revision
outputs: checked current cutting work order and requirement sections

steps.what: Read work orders and determine actual dimensions, cutting locations and quantities
inputs: checked current cutting work order and requirement sections
actual material context and order constraints
outputs: actual understood cutting dimensions, locations, quantities and unresolved ambiguities

steps.what: Write and check actually required cutting notes or clarification requests in the internal job record
inputs: actual understood cutting dimensions, locations, quantities and unresolved ambiguities
outputs: checked saved actual cutting instruction notes and unresolved issues

tasks.design: Configure a job-linked current order/section view in the actual production work-order application, OTHER. Retain all reading, dimensional interpretation and actually required written cutting notes; ordinary saving stays ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: The current assigned order and its cutting sections can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job/section links reduce locating without interpreting cutting instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual material, dimensions and cutting locations must be understood correctly.
tasks.human_edge: The cutter identifies an ambiguous dimension before marking or cutting material.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native current work-order links can reduce locating while actual cutting requirement interpretation stays human.

assumptions: Provisional source10 removes two navigation points; eight relevance/revision-check points remain. Actual production planner supplies job id, order revision, dimensions, location references and quantity; cutter verifies interpretation and handles missing/ambiguous details manually. No free OCR or model extraction is proposed.

Written notes10 only if actually required by this route, otherwise remove/reweight; no new form is assigned merely to create savings. All such writing/checking stays retained, including ungated ordinary save. Paper-only work or existing job links has no new navigation benefit. No cutting-machine command or external send is assumed.
unknowns: Does the actual work-order route require repeated digital navigation?
research_questions: Can job links preserve the current cutting order revision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 order-navigation points minus0.3 upkeep=1.7. Low: an unfamiliar order needs fresh section reading and clarification, leaving only0.5 job/current-order locating point removable, minus0.3=0.2. All dimension/location interpretation and actual notes remain; paper-only or already linked orders yield no new benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Separate actual materials or products by physical characteristics.

steps.what: Assess actual material size, weight, type, condition, color or shade against sorting requirements
inputs: actual sorting requirements and physical references
outputs: actual checked material classifications and uncertainties

steps.what: Separate materials or products physically into the appropriate actual groups
inputs: actual checked material classifications and uncertainties
actual materials or products and sorting area
outputs: actual separated material or product groups

tasks.design: Keep actual characteristic checks and physical separation with the cutter. A native stock/sort specification view can present criteria, but it does not perform these physical assessments and movements; no automated vision or handling system is defined here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials must actually be inspected and moved into groups.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change removes the defined physical sorting actions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual shade, condition and safe physical separation depend on real materials.
tasks.human_edge: The cutter notices a condition or shade mismatch in the actual material.
tasks.altitude: No supported saving in physical assessment and sorting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a sorting-criteria display does not physically inspect and separate materials.

assumptions: Provisional assessment25 and physical separation75 are scenario shares, not measured. Record/write/report/send boundaries inspected: this physical separation scenario includes no assigned stock transaction, written quality log or electronic handoff. If such work is actually owned, add its own step and assess native inventory/quality forms before applying this zero; do not hide it in physical sorting.

No automatic image capture, classifications, conveyor or robot is proposed. The digest's inspection-system examples do not establish a working vision/handling change for this hand cutter. A native specification view alone leaves these actual actions unchanged; no administrative baseline is invented.
unknowns: Does actual separation include an assigned inventory or quality-record transaction?
research_questions: Is any information work actually repeated apart from physical assessment and movement?

incremental.description: No software change is proposed, so no incremental maintenance work is assigned.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both bounds retain physical characteristic assessment25 and actual separation75. No defined software change removes either action. Any actual stock/quality record must be separately represented and assessed before applying this zero; it is not assumed free or folded into sorting.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce actual order navigation where present while retaining hand-cutting interpretation and handling.
skills_to_grow: Check current order revisions and dimensional ambiguities
Recognize actual material condition and shade differences
role.ambitious_version: Keep cutting requirements clear without inventing paperwork or claiming physical sorting savings from software alone.
